name: Firis Hagerhelm
original_name: フィリス・ハガルヘルム
source:
A high elf in a aristocratic position among the other elves, she is very prideful and looks down on the other elves.

She has an interest in the creature known as man (that she is seeing for the first time) and the concept of making children.

[spoiler]1201 years old.[/spoiler]
